newsitem.title: USA: Springs sees earnings growth opportunities.
newsitem.headline: Springs sees earnings growth opportunities.

text.p: Home furnishings manufacturer Springs Industries Inc said Tuesday it sees opportunities for earnings growth as it makes adjustments to improve efficiency.
"Opportunities for earnings growth continue as we implement our investment and consolidation strategies to enhance productivity, reduce costs and improve quality and service," it said.
"We plan to accelerate capital spending for 1997 and to focus these investments on manufacturing equipment, distribution facilities and information systems," it said.
Springs, based in Fort Mill, S.C., reported net income for the first quarter of $0.55 per share, down from $0.60 a year ago.
Excluding the effect of realignment expenses associated with the restructuring of its fabric manufacturing operations, announced in June, net income was $0.63 per share, it said.
